RAN5 obviously has their agenda and TDoc reservation setup very differently than RAN4, e.g., the same spec can be discussed in vastly different agenda items/WIs and different sub-agenda items can be assigned to different clauses of the same spec. In order to optimize the handling of contributions, it is suggested for RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group to encourage each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions. Especially, editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda by each company item should be combined to avoid multiple CRs in the same agenda item. Whether this guidance should be captured in a PRD, e.g., PRD18 (“General processes and practices”), could be discussed separately. We realize that there are exceptions and sometimes separate CRs to a TR/TS might be needed, e.g., essential corrections. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item. Discussion: Keysight USA: concerning proposal 1, it is mostly seen per agenda item, not as an overall recommendation to reduce nr. of docs. Electronic Meeting 9 – 20 Nov 2020 Purpose: For information In order to assist RAN5 delegates to plan their submissions over the next 3 months, the deadlines that cover the period 23 Nov 2020 – 22 Feb 2021 are provided below: * It should be noted that company contributions (i.e. those not formally agreed at the WG) may be submitted directly to the RAN Plenary (independently of RAN5). I will present contributions on behalf of a company at the Plenary (wearing my Chair hat) if requested. The benefit of uploading documents on time is to ensure that interested parties have a reasonable time (a minimum of 5 working days for a regular meeting) to review the documents prior to the start of the RAN5 meeting. This is especially important for CRs that require a verdict at the meeting. Late docs may still be uploaded to the reflector but whilst tolerance is often shown by delegates, such documents may be deferred if more time is requested. It should also be noted that delegates must take care to select the correct agenda item, Work Item Code, TS version number when using the 3GU. Failure to do so creates nugatory work for the Secretary and wastes meeting time. It may also mean that documents could be presented for approval at the Plenary incorrectly with the possibility that such documents are rejected.
